parsed.post: Discarding LR 0.12 (1.0644 vs 1.0401). High LR seems to cause instability at this capacity/budget. Reverting to DEPTH=8/ASPECT_RATIO=64/LR=0.1. Next: I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 and increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.05 to stabilize the larger width (AR64) configuration.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate and adding more warmup to stabilize the high-capacity (AR64) model.
